# `assets/render/ModelRenderer.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/render/ModelRenderer.js`

engine/assets/render/ModelRenderer.js — the batteries-included way to draw an EngineModel. It composes the small render modules (ModelShader + ModelGpu) and the vehicle wheel-spin helper, applying sensible DEFAULTS so any engine system can go from "I have an EngineModel" to "it's on screen" in two calls:  const r = createModelRenderer(device, { format }); await r.setModel(model, { wheelSpin: true, rig });   // upload + drawables per frame: r.render(pass, { mvp, eye, distance });  The caller still owns the render pass + camera (so it slots into any pipeline); the renderer owns the model's GPU lifetime and offers a depth-texture + camera- framing convenience. Override the shader/format/cull via opts when needed.
